SELECT * FROM vw_sales_daily
WHERE sales_date BETWEEN #{dateRange.startDate} AND #{dateRange.endDate}

choose.when: SELECT sales_date AS salesDate, sales_hour AS salesHour, sales_minute AS salesMinute, order_count AS orderCount, canceled_order_count AS canceledOrderCount, gross_sales_amount AS grossSalesAmount, canceled_amount AS canceledAmount, net_sales_amount AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE(ROUND(net_sales_amount / NULLIF(order_count, 0), 0), 0) AS averageOrderAmount, COALESCE( ROUND( canceled_order_count / NULLIF(order_count + canceled_order_count, 0) * 100, 2 ), 0 ) AS cancelRate FROM vw_sales_30min WHERE sales_date = #{salesDate} ORDER BY sales_hour, sales_minute
choose.otherwise: SELECT sales_date AS salesDate, sales_hour AS salesHour, 0 AS salesMinute, SUM(order_count) AS orderCount, SUM(canceled_order_count) AS canceledOrderCount, SUM(gross_sales_amount) AS grossSalesAmount, SUM(canceled_amount) AS canceledAmount, SUM(net_sales_amount) AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(net_sales_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0), 0), 0) AS averageOrderAmount, COALESCE( ROUND( SUM(canceled_order_count) / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) + SUM(canceled_order_count), 0) * 100, 2 ), 0 ) AS cancelRate FROM vw_sales_30min WHERE sales_date = #{salesDate} GROUP BY sales_date, sales_hour ORDER BY sales_hour

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(net_sales_amount), 0) AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE(MAX(order_count), 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(MAX(average_order_amount), 0) AS averageOrderAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vw_order_live) AS activeOrderCount FROM vw_sales_daily WHERE sales_date = #{date}

SELECT order_no AS orderNo, order_type_code AS orderType, menu_summary AS menuSummary, total_price AS totalAmount, status_code AS orderStatus, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%H:%i') AS createdAtLabel FROM vw_order_list_summary ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT status_name AS label, SUM(order_count) AS count, CASE status_code WHEN 'PREPARING' THEN 'preparing' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 'complete' WHEN 'CANCELED' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'waiting' END AS tone FROM vw_order_status_summary WHERE order_date = #{date} GROUP BY status_code, status_name ORDER BY status_code

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu WHERE sold_out = 1) AS menuSoldOut, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ing WHERE sold_out = 1) AS ingredientSoldOut, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opt_item WHERE sold_out = 1) AS optionSoldOut
SELECT * FROM vw_sales_daily WHERE sales_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY sales_date
